I've seen the cowdata stuff come up a few times now in various issues. As far as I can tell it's related to improper vector access (i.e. if you try to access a vector with greater than the size, it'll crash). The problem seems to be that most of the codepaths accessing vectors isn't guarded against checking vector size before trying to access it.

I am also experiencing the same issue, I have found that this happens when there is at least 1 addon enabled, and in console output there is a duplicated output for "Unloading addon: res://addons/..." so maybe there is some double-free taking place.

The OP's log also has this duplicate log (`Unloading addon: res://addons/Todo_Manager/plugin.cfg`)

This does reproduce for me in cloud mac and container linux, but does not reproduce on normal mac and normal windows.

Edit: Another workaround found, instead of `--quit` it works if I use `--quit-after 5`, (--quit-after 1 not always enough)
